thread:
kevin: Heads-up — I'd like to run a short soak today to validate the burst-steering change + KV-cache warmup fix. Target: reproduce the 95th p99 tail we saw on thursday and confirm no extra mem churn. Can folks help with profiling + tracing?

suzanne: I'm available for profiling. do you want flamegraphs + async stacks? also need the run window id.

kevin: flamegraphs + perf maps please. run window id = replay-2026-03-17-a. planning a 20m soak (10m ramp, 10m steady). aiming for 3pm PT.

aria: I can capture kv cache hit/miss metrics and the runtime batch stats. will add dashboards. quick Q: are we using k6 replay or locust for this one?

kevin: k6 for traffic fidelity (we have the k6 replay script derived from prod traces). locust would be heavier to instrument for KV hits.

aj: i'll take the locust smoke if we need followup. for k6, i'll prepare the sampling hooks to collect pprof stacks.

kevin: thank you. sample command i'm going to run:```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 20m --out influxdb=http://influx:8086 replay-script.js 
```
this script replays prefix distributions and includes the trace IDs so we can tie logs to spans.

tim: small note — if we push VUs too quickly the steering logic may cap early; please ramp over 10m like you said. also i'll open a quick canary to route 5% to the new steering policy so we can compare.

kevin: good call. canary 5% + 95% baseline. will set up in the routing config.

replay-bot: Scheduled replay run replay-2026-03-17-a by kevin at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z — k6, 20m window, payloads from bucket s3://replays/2026/03/17/trace-batch-7.json

suzanne: for flamegraphs: I'll run `perf record -F 99 -g -- sleep 900` against the runtime process during the steady window and then generate with `perf script | stackcollapse-perf.pl | flamegraph.pl > runA.svg`. also will collect pprof at 1s sampling from the hotpath.

kevin: perfect. please tag the artifacts with run id (replay-2026-03-17-a). bucket: gs://redwood-soaks/replays.

aria: quick dashboard panels i'll add: kv_cache.hit_rate, kv_cache.latency_ms{p95,p99}, runtime.batches.size, runtime.kv_cache.evictions. also adding a heatmap for seq_len distribution.

aj: will wire the tracing sampling to 5% for end-to-end traces so we don't drown the collector. can route the sampled spans to a separate dataset labeled `soak/replay-2026-03-17-a`.

kevin: can someone own post-run regression checks? checklist: 1) compare p95/p99 token latency baseline vs experiment 2) check memory delta 3) verify no unusual GC spikes 4) inspect flamegraphs for new hot loops 5) confirm kv cache hit improvement

tim: i'll owner the p95/p99 comparison and GC checks.

suzanne: i'll do flamegraph diffs and the perf artifacts.

aria: i'll verify the kv cache metrics and upload dashboards.

kevin: thanks all. pinging infra: @deploy-bot please reserve 8 gpus on the dedicated pool from 21:50Z-22:30Z for this run (we might oversub for short bursts).

deploy-bot: request received — reserving 8 GPUs in pool `dedicated-soak-1`. ETA: reserved.

kevin: I'll start the replay at 21:55Z to allow warmup. if anyone wants to join the greenroom voice at 21:45Z that'd be great.

aj: 👍 will join. also preflight checklist: verify disk iops quota, ensure sample exporter is healthy, check that the kv cache flags are toggled for the new steering code.

tim: noted — I pushed a small flag toggle PR (#4123). can someone LGTM?

aria: LGTM on #4123, small comment inline.

kevin: thanks. last-minute asks: if p99 jumps >10% abort and revert routing to 0% for the steering policy. otherwise collect artifacts and we will triage.

suzanne: copy. will snapshot logs and marker events at `--marker replay-2026-03-17-a` so we can filter quickly.

kevin: great. see you all in the greenroom.

replay-bot: run started replay-2026-03-17-a at 2026-03-17T21:55:20Z (k6 VUs=200, steady=10m). logs: https://console.redwood/replays/replay-2026-03-17-a

aj: started attaching pprof collectors now.

tim: seeing initial ramp — p95 is holding. will update at steady mark. :eyes:

suzanne: perf recording started.

aria: dashboards live, kv cache hit rate looks +6% compared to baseline already.

kevin: excellent. i'll wait for steady window snapshots then we can start regression checks.

aj: steady window reached, capturing traces and pprofs now.

replay-bot: run finished replay-2026-03-17-a at 2026-03-17T22:15:43Z. artifacts: gs://redwood-soaks/replays/replay-2026-03-17-a/*.tgz

kevin: thanks team — please upload your artifacts to the bucket and add short notes in the run doc (shared drive link). I'll do a quick triage and post follow-ups here.

suzanne: uploaded perf and flamegraphs -> gs://redwood-soaks/replays/replay-2026-03-17-a/perf/

aria: dashboards and KV panels saved; run doc updated with initial numbers.

tim: p95 +2%, p99 -1%, no GC anomalies. baseline vs experiment in the doc.

aj: traces sampled — no obvious latency spike on hot endpoints. linking trace ids in doc.

kevin: quick verdict: steering + kv warmup looks safe for broader rollout. we'll schedule a 50% canary next week and monitor for regressions. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
